result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_node_attrs()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get attribute values for nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L7337-L7410){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_node_attrs( node_attr, nodes=None, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Extracts a specific attribute from one or more nodes. Only returns entries for nodes that have the specified attribute set. Useful for collecting properties across the graph. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node_attr]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Attribute name to extract. [nodes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int | str] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional list of node IDs (int) or labels (str) to query. If `None`, queries all nodes. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict[int, any]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Dictionary mapping node IDs to attribute values. Only includes nodes that have the attribute set. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Only nodes that actually have the attribute set appear in the result -- here, every node has a `score`, so all three show up: ::: {#984fe34d .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A", type="user", score=95) .add_node(label="B", type="admin", score=88) .add_node(label="C", type="user", score=92) ) graph.get_node_attrs("score") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {2: 88, 3: 92, 1: 95} ``` ::: ::: Any attribute name works the same way: ::: {#f8f12fbc .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph.get_node_attrs("type") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` {2: 'admin', 3: 'user', 1: 'user'} ``` ::: ::: Passing `nodes=` narrows the result down to specific node IDs: ::: {#c80402bf .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} node_ids = list(graph.get_node_ids()) graph.get_node_attrs("score", nodes=[node_ids[0], node_ids[2]]) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` {2: 88, 1: 95} ``` ::: ::: Labels work just as well as IDs: ::: {#d30cb27c .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph.get_node_attrs("score", nodes=["A", "C"]) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` {1: 95, 3: 92} ``` ::: :::
